notices.title: Welcome to the Fallen Stars playtest!
notices.body:
Thank you for helping to test Fallen Stars!
· Download the Windows or Android version at the top of this page; the steps are under "How to install".
· During the test, numbers and content may change at any time, and there will sometimes be maintenance. Maintenance is announced here and in the game beforehand.
· Found a bug, got stuck, or felt something was too hard or too easy? Tell Akane directly; a screenshot helps a lot.
Have fun!
notices.bodyZh:
感谢你来帮忙测试《落星》！
· 下载：在本页上方选择 Windows 或 Android 版本，安装步骤见「安装说明」。
· 测试期间，数值和内容可能随时调整，偶尔也会维护。维护会提前在这里和游戏内公告。
· 遇到 bug、卡关，或者觉得哪里太难、太简单，欢迎直接告诉 Akane，附上截图更好。
祝你玩得开心！
